properties.description: A reference implementation showing how to stand up a recurring-billing subscription payment page using Stripe Checkout and Stripe Billing together, without needing a custom server for the payment flow itself. Covers subscription tier selection (e.g. Basic/Premium), Checkout Session creation, customer record tracking across renewals, Apple Pay and card payments, dynamic 3D Secure/SCA authentication, and optional automated sales tax via Stripe Tax. Provided in eight parallel server implementations (Node, Ruby, Python, Java, PHP, Go, .NET) with 25+ language localization.
